items.claim: Jamal Emmers does not have a reliable chin and has been knocked out several times.
items.quote: I never thought he had the best chin. He's been knocked out several times.

items.claim: Jamal Emmers often fails to utilize his wrestling advantage in fights.
items.quote: you can really never count on Jamal Emmers to go out there and wrestle.

items.claim: Larry Douglas possesses the power to knock out most fighters in the featherweight division.
items.quote: Douglas absolutely has the power to put out most guys in the division.

items.claim: Larry Douglas has been finished in most of his losses.
items.quote: Douglas has been finished in most of his losses.

items.claim: Larry Douglas is one of the hardest hitters, if not the hardest hitter, in the featherweight division.
items.quote: he's one of the hardest hitters, if not the hardest hitter in the featherweight division.

items.claim: Jax McVey has one of the best clinch games in the middleweight division, featuring nasty knees and elbows.
items.quote: Probably one of the best clinch games in the middleweight division. um nasty with knees and elbows

items.claim: Wes Schultz dislikes getting hit and pulled guard early in his last fight.
items.quote: Wes Schultz does clearly not like getting hit. Um he pulled guard within like the first minute of his last fight.

items.claim: Wes Schultz shoots sloppy, long-range takedowns.
items.quote: his wrestling entries are just so bad. He's shooting from so far out. He's shooting in all these sloppy takedowns.
